results.title: Verify, restore a backup taken before that verification
results.evidence: the chain was restored to seq 10 and the checkpoint still reads 13, three ahead of it. The cheap check answers valid over 0 node(s) — `since(mark)` finds nothing past a mark the chain no longer reaches, and nothing compares the two. A restore is the one operation that produces this state and the one nobody re-verifies afterwards
